newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Stals sees no need for SAfrica IMF loan yet - report.
newsitem.headline: Stals sees no need for SAfrica IMF loan yet - report.

text.p: South African Reserve Bank Governor Chris Stals said he would advise government to apply for a loan from the International Monetary Fund (IMF) if there were no signs of the country's balance of payments improving over the next few months.
But Business Report newspaper quoted the central bank head saying there was no crisis and there were early signs that the current account deficit was narrowing.
"We don't think we really have a crisis on our hands. We think the process is already in progress to reduce the deficit on the current account," he said.
"Should we not get evidence (of this) in the next few months, I will certainly feel the time has come for the government to approach the IMF.
"If there is a need to approach the IMF, I will have no problem approaching the government to do so," he said.
